reviews.title: Not loving this app
reviews.text: Need some instructions and some search functions

reviews.title: So much missing
reviews.text: Comparing the site to the app, there is so much missing. The site has a lot of forum categories and different ways to interact with the community, but the app only shows me forums from more than a decade ago. It’s a little clunky and not really what I expected.

reviews.title: Constant connection cues
reviews.text: This app was great. I am already logged in but it can’t load a single thing without cueing me to login again. Now it is unusable.

reviews.title: Mon-functional
reviews.text: I used to use this app a lot. However, it no longer connects to Ravelry. I get an error message that there are difficulties connecting and my user name and password just disappear.  I can still access my account by going in through my browser directly to Traveler, just can no longer use this convenient app.

reviews.title: Please fix log in bug!!!
reviews.text: This app no longer leaves me signed in to Ravelry. I have to log in every time I open it. It did not used to do this please fix it!!!!

reviews.title: Cannot connect to ravelry
reviews.text: Every time I just input a search value it gives me an error Dayi g “cannot reach ravelry”. This app is basically useless now.

reviews.title: Kind of crummy
reviews.text: Tried to pull money from my account without an active subscription in the App Store

reviews.title: New upgrade is bad
reviews.text: The new upgrade is just bad. Been using Ravit for 6 years and now I’m not able to edit photos in the app to upload, not all my favorites bundles are loading for me to save to… and they have to reload every time I try to save something??Very bad user experience now.  I wish I never did the update and could go back to the old version. :’(

reviews.title: Used to work great
reviews.text: loved Ravit for a long time. Great user friendly way to navigate ravelry. My only wish was that the yarn suggestions section of ravelry was available when viewing designs/project planning. Since the most recent update, unfortunately Ravit seems to have a lot of bugs and either needs to be reconnected to my ravelry account or will not work at all and needs to be uninstalled and reinstalled about 35% of the time. Unfortunate, hope they can work out the bugs.
